name: HD-DVD
what_failed: Toshiba's high-definition optical disc format lost to Blu-ray in a 2-year format war.
why_it_failed: Blu-ray had Sony's manufacturing scale and PlayStation 3 bundling
Major studios (Disney, Fox) backed Blu-ray exclusively
Streaming was already emerging, making both formats transitional
assumptions_that_broke: Format wars still matter in the streaming era
Consumers would wait for format resolution
resurrection_conditions: Lesson applies to any transitional technology
lesson: Fighting a format war is futile when the underlying constraint (physical distribution) is about to be eliminated entirely. Both HD-DVD and Blu-ray lost to streaming.
